rationale: Chosen analytically before any candidate evaluation (GATE_0_SPEC.md §4.4). A: n = 7-8 needed documents so that the one-shot router's best compromise (dividing with k = 2-4 in both members) loses about 0.05 against the oracle; long documents sized so that answering alone still scores >= 0.3 in the urgent long member. B: a slow memo (~100-120 s) so that speculation pays in the member where the heavy unit is live, and a heavy unit (~150 s) that is still on the critical path after the memo in the member where it is dead; sized so that the best organization still scores >= 0.5. Three instances per template, in different domains, so that at least two per template can qualify if the template is viable. D is Experiment 0b's T01 with every region report shortened.
